primary: full two-stage task independently verified with exact post-step state and 30 consecutive stable control samples
checkpoint: fixed final 65536 updates-completed checkpoint; no test-based model selection
secondary: completion time, all and matched-success cases separately
validation_mid_checkpoint: 32768 updates-completed checkpoint for residual/recover, 32 cases; no best-checkpoint selection
unit_of_training_uncertainty: independent training seed, not repeated cases pooled as independent trials
hybrid_pilot: Development only unless its predeclared validation promotion criterion passes; do not inspect final tests to select it
